text:
Type: shaggy high pile area rug
Use: soft warmth underfoot beside a bed or under a coffee table; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, minimalist, Scandinavian
Materials: long thick synthetic shag pile
Colors: medium grey, cool tone
Shape: plain rectangle with dense fluffy shag, soft uneven edges, solid color, thick and plush
Feel: cozy, soft, relaxed
Goes with: white or grey sofas, light wood, black or chrome accents; modern, Scandinavian or minimalist living rooms and bedrooms

product.name: HAMPEN
product.description: Durable, stain resistant and easy to care for since the rug is made of synthetic fibres.
